entries.reason: Tier 1, through these adapters alone. A program names adapters and their config, never the engine's methods. The host makes the passes and the camera; instances use the 14-float layout; every batch is opaque, depth on, both faces drawn.

Tier 1, through these adapters alone. ng.geometry.primitive: the thirteen primitives and the host's ground, from one size (fixed proportions) and segments. The plane stands upright (XY, facing +Z). No custom geometry, megabuffers or meshlets.
Needs GLB asset files; Wexy has no asset allowlist, so a program cannot name one.

Tier 1, through these adapters alone. ng.material.stock: kind and baseColor only, no maps (matcap is refused). Basic, lambert, toon and emissive multiply baseColor by the instance colour; pbr ignores it and draws as a rough metal.
Wexy's host measures GPU time itself; a program never asks for it.
Developer overlays and debug drawings; never part of a world.
Wexy's host owns the camera: it frames the world when shown, and the creator orbits it and sets its keyframes. A program cannot move it: a world must read well from any side.

Tier 1, through these adapters alone. ng.light.rig: ambient, at most one directional and four point lights, set once at init (they never move); standard technique. The ambient arrives from straight above: downward faces get none. Only lambert, toon and pbr are lit.

Tier 1, through these adapters alone. ng.post.chain: the sixteen built-in effects, one intensity each (0 to 4), run in the program's order; no CustomEffect. Without a chain the background is a fixed dark grey.
